meta.title: Rishta Safe: couple-result companion
meta.description: A prototype that explains a reported premarital genetic screening result in plain language, shows who can see what, and follows the real pathway. Synthetic data. Education and decision support, never clinical advice.

lens.label: Lens
lens.dialogTitle: Choose a case and a lens
lens.fallbackHint: Pick a seeded synthetic persona. The Case bench lists every case against every lens.

tape.label: Audit
tape.verified: hash chain intact, {count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}}

footer.label: Footer
footer.what: Rishta Safe is a prototype on synthetic data. It is not a medical device.
footer.simulated: Every connection to a health service or registry is simulated and labelled as simulated.
footer.noIntegration: There is no integration with Emirates Health Services, Malaffi, the Emirati Genome Programme, DoH or DHA.

needPersona.title: Choose a demo persona to continue

body.couple: This page shows one person's own journey. Pick a couple member in the demo to see it.
body.counsellor: The counsellor console shows the escalation queue and the one-page brief. Pick the counsellor persona to open it.
body.clinician: The haematology aid is for clinicians. Pick the clinician persona to open it.
body.programme: Programme figures are aggregate and synthetic. Pick the programme operator persona to open them.
body.judge: The scoreboard is a read-only evaluation view. Pick the judge persona to open it.

states.errorBody: Nothing has been lost. You can try again, and if it keeps happening, quote the reference below.
states.notFoundTitle: This page does not exist in the prototype
states.notFoundBody: The address may be mistyped, or the page was never part of this prototype. Open the Case bench or go back to the start.
